name: Ehlitte
source:
The listless Princess who has an immense interest in the erotic?

Profession: Princess
Country: The distant realm of Elfheim
Race: Elf
Height: Tall
Breast size: Smaller than others, yes, but still quite big

In the far off kingdom of Elfheim, the elves live in peace and harmony. Under instruction from the King who desires nothing but peace, the princess Eritte arrives to receive the seed of the hero.

Though rather somber and always bringing a downer mood to those around her, Eritte actually really loves lewd things.
She also really loves the protagonist, who managed to become her very first partner. 

Elves being elves, they spend most of their time living in the forest... which makes them a little lacking when it comes to common sense. As a member of Royalty, she bears no family name.

「Guess there's no way around it... It's for the peace of the world and all that. I'll bear your child...」
